title: Max Schuemann 2025 Topps Series 1 Spring Training Palm Foil 305 Oakland A’s
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2025 Topps Series 1 Spring Training Palm Foil trading card featuring Max Schuemann of the Oakland Athletics. This original card is made of card stock and is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) league. It is a standard size card with a foil parallel/variety design, manufactured by Topps in the United States. The card is not autographed and is not a vintage reprint, making it a valuable addition to any baseball trading card collection.
